caption:
The average new credit card offer now sits around 22.46% APR. 💳

WalletHub's November report puts existing accounts at about 21.19%.

On a $5,000 balance, that's roughly $90 a month in interest if you only carry it.

Does your card's APR surprise you when you look at it?
